ui.mg.waiting: Waiting for the rest of Mission Control…
ui.mg.modes.title: How you play
ui.mg.modes.relaxed_desc: Wider safe zones and a guide.
ui.mg.modes.relaxed_room: Relaxed mode is on for everyone.
ui.mg.modes.one_button_desc: Play with a single press anywhere.
ui.mg.sitout.title: Sit this one out
ui.mg.sitout.body: This challenge is not on this phone yet. Cheer the crew on: the flight continues either way.
ui.mg.late.title: Almost over
ui.mg.late.body: You reconnected near the end of this challenge. You are in for the next one.
ui.mg.own.success_body: Your result is in. A boost depends on how many of the crew make it.
ui.mg.own.miss_body: No harm done: the flight continues normally. The crew can still earn the boost.
ui.mg.result.no_boost: No boost this time, and nothing lost. The rocket flies on as planned.
ui.mg.result.sparkle: Not enough for a boost, but the crew earned a sparkle of style.
minigame.MG-08.name: Max Q Throttle Bucket
minigame.MG-08.how_to_play: Slide the throttle so the stress line stays inside the safe band.
minigame.MG-08.success: Stay in the band at least 85 % of the time.
minigame.MG-08.hint.drag: Drag up or down anywhere to move the throttle
minigame.MG-08.hint.hold: Hold anywhere: throttle up. Let go: throttle down.
minigame.MG-08.hint.toggle: Tap anywhere to switch between throttle up and down
minigame.MG-08.aria.lever: Throttle. Arrow keys move it; keep the stress line inside the safe band.
